snippet.title: Sab Se Behtar Kaun? Daulat Nahin, Ohda Nahin… | Sahih Bukhari 5027 #shorts
snippet.description:
Tum mein sab se behtar kaun hai? Jawab sun kar aap hairan reh jaayenge!

Hazrat Usman-e-Ghani (Radi Allahu Anhu) se riwayat hai ke Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) ne farmaya:
«خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ»
"Tum mein sab se behtar woh hai, jo Quran seekhe aur doosron ko sikhaaye."

Reference
• Sahih al-Bukhari 5027: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:5027

Daulat nahin, ohda nahin... balke Quran! Aaj ek aayat khud bhi seekhein, aur ek aayat apne bachon ko sikhaayein. Comment mein likhein: In sha Allah! Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
